classification: CIVILIAN RESEARCH / CONDITIONAL DEMILITARIZATION, NEVER MANDATE
principles: Rights and legal sovereignty cannot be bargained away by this tool.
A ceasefire or weapons-restraint proposal does not constitute disarmament or settlement.
All inter-party obligations require competent party consent and credible verification.
Observers, IAEA, OSCE, UN and NGOs have only the authority their mandates provide.
No tactical coordinates, targeting support, protected-person data or live monitoring telemetry.
Civilian safety, voluntary participation, ecology and anti-corruption are independently reviewed.

scenarioBlocks.title: Protected services and reciprocal restraint
scenarioBlocks.objective: Reduce attacks affecting essential civilian power, water, heat, hospitals and communications without compromising civilian protection obligations.
scenarioBlocks.proposedReviewers: Proposed negotiating parties and independent humanitarian technical assessors
scenarioBlocks.reciprocity: A jointly documented sector-specific reciprocal commitment, separately verified through lawful channels.
scenarioBlocks.verification: Publicly defined covered facilities and scope; independently sampled disruption trends; contested-incident escalation within agreed timelines.
scenarioBlocks.limitations: A declaration alone cannot establish compliance. Avoid publishing sensitive infrastructure or monitoring locations.
scenarioBlocks.metrics: Civilian service interruption duration, civilian harm reports and verified access approvals; specify baseline and uncertainty.
scenarioBlocks.classification: UNVERIFIED POLICY SCENARIO — no agreement, authority or field status implied

scenarioBlocks.title: Nuclear-site safety and repair access
scenarioBlocks.objective: Protect nuclear safety functions and safe repair access, with no claim of coercive authority by technical inspectors.
scenarioBlocks.proposedReviewers: Relevant state authorities, plant safety personnel, regulators and IAEA subject to actual mandate
scenarioBlocks.reciprocity: Mutually agreed limitations on acts jeopardizing nuclear safety, and safe access for critical repairs.
scenarioBlocks.verification: Independent technical safety status; electricity supply reliability; verified permission for repairs.
scenarioBlocks.limitations: IAEA monitoring is not enforcement; data on sensitive systems must remain protected.
scenarioBlocks.metrics: Off-site power availability and independently confirmed safety/repair milestones.
scenarioBlocks.classification: UNVERIFIED POLICY SCENARIO — no agreement, authority or field status implied

scenarioBlocks.title: Ceasefire verification and incident dispute process
scenarioBlocks.objective: Design an authorized, civilian-safe monitoring, evidence retention, hotline and violation review framework.
scenarioBlocks.proposedReviewers: Ukraine and Russia through authorized channels; independent observers only if formally mandated
scenarioBlocks.reciprocity: Joint definitions and signed commitments are prerequisites to considering separation or ceasefire lines.
scenarioBlocks.verification: Authenticated delayed aggregate reporting, independent incident review and right of reply.
scenarioBlocks.limitations: Former OSCE SMM closed in 2022. A new mandate and safety arrangements are essential; no live tactical feeds.
scenarioBlocks.metrics: Proportion of independently reviewable alleged incidents; access refusals; defined resolution time.
scenarioBlocks.classification: UNVERIFIED POLICY SCENARIO — no agreement, authority or field status implied

scenarioBlocks.title: Reciprocal heavy-weapons restraint feasibility
scenarioBlocks.objective: Compare candidate restraints on heavy weapons as reciprocal and reversible hypotheses, not imposed territorial concessions.
scenarioBlocks.proposedReviewers: Authorized negotiating and implementing parties; independent monitors if invited and legally mandated
scenarioBlocks.reciprocity: Consider a 30 km study assumption only after agreement on what is measured, geographic scope and protection of civilians.
scenarioBlocks.verification: Delayed aggregated compliance observations and structured dispute resolution, without sharing live troop positions.
scenarioBlocks.limitations: Specific distance is not agreed or independently established as optimal; no tactical coordinates, targeting data or deployment instructions.
scenarioBlocks.metrics: Percentage of defined restraints independently confirmed under a mandate; incidents by category; civilian safety review.
scenarioBlocks.classification: UNVERIFIED POLICY SCENARIO — no agreement, authority or field status implied

scenarioBlocks.title: Protected-person exchanges and family tracing
scenarioBlocks.objective: Enable safe humanitarian contact, independently safeguarded exchanges and missing-person tracing under applicable law.
scenarioBlocks.proposedReviewers: Relevant parties and neutral humanitarian organizations only with their explicit consent
scenarioBlocks.reciprocity: Separate legally required protection of civilians, wounded people and detainees from political concessions.
scenarioBlocks.verification: Independent humanitarian reporting using aggregate indicators; confidential identifying data never published.
scenarioBlocks.limitations: No coercive conditionality, public lists of identifiable protected people or unsafe movement details.
scenarioBlocks.metrics: Safely completed transfers against independently confirmed, privacy-preserving baselines.
scenarioBlocks.classification: UNVERIFIED POLICY SCENARIO — no agreement, authority or field status implied

scenarioBlocks.title: Civilian maritime access and de-risking
scenarioBlocks.objective: Explore lawful merchant-shipping safety protocols compatible with sovereignty, navigation law and insurer requirements.
scenarioBlocks.proposedReviewers: Flag states, competent maritime regulators, shipping owners, IMO and affected parties as authorized
scenarioBlocks.reciprocity: Any humanitarian maritime route requires explicit coordination, security assurance, and navigational safety assessment.
scenarioBlocks.verification: Aggregate publicly available AIS patterns corroborated with independent maritime records and protected commercial information.
scenarioBlocks.limitations: AIS gaps and deliberate manipulation mean vessel tracks alone cannot prove safety; no autonomous passage authorization.
scenarioBlocks.metrics: Confirmed safe merchant passages and independently documented shipping incidents; no live ship targeting data.
scenarioBlocks.classification: UNVERIFIED POLICY SCENARIO — no agreement, authority or field status implied

scenarioBlocks.title: Longer-term arms transparency and de-escalation
scenarioBlocks.objective: Develop non-prejudicial confidence-building and arms transparency scenarios with voluntary reporting.
scenarioBlocks.proposedReviewers: Competent national governments and authorized international forums
scenarioBlocks.reciprocity: Review OSCE Vienna Document practices while respecting current validity, sovereignty and parties’ decision authority.
scenarioBlocks.verification: Mutual information exchange formats and appropriately protected independent compliance reviews.
scenarioBlocks.limitations: Transparency cannot substitute for credible security, nor justify imposing unilateral vulnerability.
scenarioBlocks.metrics: Frequency of agreed, independently verified information exchanges and formal dispute resolutions.
scenarioBlocks.classification: UNVERIFIED POLICY SCENARIO — no agreement, authority or field status implied

scenarioBlocks.title: Certified mine action and safe land release
scenarioBlocks.objective: Prioritize civilian and agricultural return through community-led survey and accredited clearance with AI as decision support only.
scenarioBlocks.proposedReviewers: Ukrainian mine-action authorities, certified operators, affected communities
scenarioBlocks.reciprocity: Require IMAS-compliant assessment, accreditation, quality control and documented land-release authority.
scenarioBlocks.verification: Field validation, accredited quality assurance and lawful land release; AI screening is not clearance.
scenarioBlocks.limitations: No unmanned autonomous explosive clearance instructions; no public mine coordinates or hazard-sensitive records.
scenarioBlocks.metrics: Documented safe hectares released through approved procedures, independently sampled QA outcomes.
scenarioBlocks.classification: UNVERIFIED POLICY SCENARIO — no agreement, authority or field status implied

scenarioBlocks.title: Demobilization, recovery and reintegration safeguards
scenarioBlocks.objective: Support voluntary survivor-centered reintegration alongside security guarantees and public services.
scenarioBlocks.proposedReviewers: Competent Ukrainian institutions, communities, independent health and protection experts
scenarioBlocks.reciprocity: Adapt UN DDR standards cautiously; they do not imply that the two states have authorized a DDR mission.
scenarioBlocks.verification: Service access, voluntary participation, privacy-preserving outcome review and grievance pathways.
scenarioBlocks.limitations: Avoid forced disarmament, coerced demobilization, stigmatizing labels or linking essential services to military concessions.
scenarioBlocks.metrics: Voluntary access to services, continuity of care, reported social reintegration and safeguarded long-term follow-up.
scenarioBlocks.classification: UNVERIFIED POLICY SCENARIO — no agreement, authority or field status implied

scenarioBlocks.title: Ecological and economic recovery as peace dividends
scenarioBlocks.objective: Tie independently supervised restoration to clean energy, habitat, soil and water quality, civilian employment and transparent procurement.
scenarioBlocks.proposedReviewers: Competent Ukrainian public bodies, affected localities, willing and legally empowered donors
scenarioBlocks.reciprocity: Funds must have legal appropriation, anti-corruption measures and independent procurement review.
scenarioBlocks.verification: Public audits, supplier disclosures, environmental baselines and rights-based beneficiary checks.
scenarioBlocks.limitations: Frozen sovereign principal is not automatically available; displacement and unequal benefit can worsen grievances.
scenarioBlocks.metrics: Restored civilian service-hours, verified contamination remediation and transparent contracts.
scenarioBlocks.classification: UNVERIFIED POLICY SCENARIO — no agreement, authority or field status implied
